testcase.name: Scenario: Dock the floating ribbon to the right: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-docking-source/features/application/ribbon-docking/ribbon-docking.feature:193:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Dock the floating ribbon to the right ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active and the 3D Model ribbon is docked at the top ✔ When the user undocks the ribbon ✔ And chooses Dock to Right from the floating title menu ✔ Then the ribbon tabs and command groups are arranged vertically on the right ✔ And the model browser remains on the left of the viewport ✔ When the user opens Docking Positions from the active ribbon tab ✔ Then Right is checked ✔ When the user chooses Top ✔ Then the ribbon returns to a horizontal position above the viewport ✔ And the part remains active
